jobs.title: (80 - 100%) Senior Power Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

You will join an agile, cross‑functional team of approximately 8–15 employees focused on designing and developing new products.

This role is contributing to the Power Protection/EL/SP/R&D in Switzerland.

The work model for the role is: On Site

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Working as an independent and reliable contributor in R&D projects with limited supervision.

  • Understanding and applying applicable processes, standards, guidelines, and requirements, including architectural and design constraints.

  • Driving the achievement of assigned targets (quality, time, scope, cost) and raising and addressing risks.

  • Design and develop power converters

  • Specify components and define technical requirements with suppliers

  • Support the overall design cycle of the new product, from simulation to validation and documentation, through design and test

  • Conduct and coordinate complex analyses, develop recommendations based on technology/engineering practices and business considerations

  • Support operations and after sales organization during trouble shooting phases

  • Plan and coordinate a range of complex technology/engineering activities


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Master in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with thesis in Power Electronics or Bachelors Degree in Electrical/Electronics and equivalent work experience

  • 6+ years of electrical engineering experience

  • Experience with power electronic design topologies, knowledge of UPS technology and familiarity with the power protection

  • Mastering simulation tools -MATLAB/Simulink, LT Spice- and programming language -C-

  • Good communication skills in English, both oral and written. Other languages are an asset

  • Significant experience in working within complex organization

  • Willingness to travel occasionally (10%)


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Position 76059728 Production Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Continuous Improvement Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support production process definition to ensure optimization of cost, quality, and on-time delivery of product. Each day, you will participate in the sequence definition, cycle time calculation, and analysis of the working phases of new production processes/products. You will also showcase your knowledge by sharing TPM and cycle time data and improvement ideas with internal teams.

Work model: #LI-Onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • TPM (Total Productive Maintenance):

  • Handle tool management activities, including but not limited to maintenance, purchasing, standardization, and ensuring functionality and calibration.

  • Assure production line availability assuring preventative maintenance is adhered to and review data to support improvement interventions.

  • Collaborate with internal customers and external suppliers to meet tool requirements.

  • Project Support:

  • Support Continuous Improvement Specialist with lean projects

  • Training:

  • Develop and implement training documents for TPM, 5S, ESD and other relevant areas.

  • Conduct training sessions for coworkers to enhance their skills and knowledge.

  • Time Keeping:

  • Perform time studies on all prioritized process steps to identify opportunities for improvement and increased efficiency.

  • Ensure the documented times in SAP are correct to actual base line times from your measured time study.

  • Order Processing:

  • Place and confirm orders in “Smart Buy”.

  • Tracking of orders to assure correct and timely arrival.

Your • Qualifications

  • Demonstrated a clear focus on safe work practices with a dedication to following all relevant workplace safety guidelines

  • Demonstrated work ethic characterized by motivation, willingness to handle tasks, and a willingness to take initiative.

  • Comfortable in a teaching environment with the ability to effectively communicate information to a group but also to tailor your teaching approach for individualized learning experiences.

  • Good knowledge of current tools used in operations.

  • Experience working with SAP, Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.

  • Good organization, collaborative and problem-solving skills.

  • Minimum of two years of experience in UPS manufacturing.

  • Yellow Belt certified and English language a plus

Please note that applications and CVs should be submitted in English.

More About Us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. Quality Manager

__

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità:

In questo ruolo, contribuirai all'implementazione della nostra strategia di qualità in tutta l'unità organizzativa locale, promuovendo una forte cultura della qualità e implementando sistemi efficaci, strumenti e team qualificati, tutti incentrati sul superamento delle aspettative dei clienti e sul mantenimento di operazioni sostenibili. Ogni giorno, bilancerai prevenzione, miglioramento continuo e risposta rapida alle sfide di qualità, collaborando con team interfunzionali per migliorare i risultati di qualità. Il tuo lavoro supporterà direttamente l'unità organizzativa nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi di performance e nel progresso verso standard di livello mondiale.

Il modello di lavoro per questo ruolo è in sede: #LI-Onsite #Work-Shifts

Questo ruolo contribuisce alla divisione Critical Power, Smart Power presso Quartino, Svizzera.

Sarai principalmente responsabile di:

  • Supportare attivamente le linee di produzione come primo punto di contatto per le questioni relative alla qualità.
  • Tracciare e registrare sistematicamente tutte le non conformità generate dalle linee di produzione.
  • Contribuire al miglioramento degli indicatori chiave di qualità, principalmente il First Pass Yield (FPY) e il costo complessivo della scarsa qualità (COPQ).
  • Segnalare tempestivamente e accuratamente le non conformità al fornitore.
  • Controllare, implementare e migliorare continuamente i controlli di qualità per migliorare la qualità dei prodotti e il controllo dei processi.
  • Gestire il magazzino dei prodotti non conformi e lavorare attivamente per ridurre i livelli di inventario.

• Requisiti per il ruolo:

  • Tecnico meccanico o elettrico o settore correlato.
  • Minimo 2 anni di esperienza in ruoli relativi alla qualità o equivalenti.
  • Profonda conoscenza dei processi di qualità, comprese le metodologie di risoluzione dei problemi e gli strumenti di miglioramento continuo.
  • Capacità comunicative e interpersonali con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli organizzativi.
  • Disponibilità a lavorare su turni e oltre l'orario standard quando richiesto, e capacità di lavorare in modo efficiente in situazioni impegnative.
  • La lingua principale è l'italiano, scritto e parlato.
  • La conoscenza dell'inglese è considerata un vantaggio.

Si prega di notare che le candidature e i CV devono essere inviati in inglese.

Il portafoglio della Divisione comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, applicazioni di avviamento motore e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. La sua unità Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center del mondo con soluzioni UPS avanzate ed efficienti dal punto di vista energetico. At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. This Position reports to:

Quality Manager


Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the deployment of the quality strategy for a local organizational unit, including quality culture, systems, tools, and skilled teams, with the aim to meet customer expectations while ensuring sustainable operations. Each day, you will assist the organization in creating the right mix of prevention, continuous improvement, robust root cause analysis, quick response, and sustainable solutions to problems. You will also showcase your skills by collaborating with local functions that improve the quality of results to reach the targets for the organizational unit and aim for world-class performance.

The work model for the role is onsite. #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Power Protection, Smart Power division in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Non-Conformities Management: Analyze non-conformities systematically to identify root causes and initiate cases in the Practical Problem Solving (PPS) tool to track corrective activities and ensure resolution.

  • PPS cases Management: Define containment, corrective, and preventive actions. Facilitate Level 2 Quality Circles and escalate critical cases to Level 3 when necessary.

  • Quality KPI Performance: contribute to the improvement of key quality metrics including First Pass Yield (FPY) manufacturing, Supplier PPM, Customer DPU, and overall Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ). Monitor and ensure timely closure of PPS cases.

  • Supplier Quality Management: Manage supplier non-conformities and identify top critical issues in collaboration with the Supplier Quality Manager to improve initiatives.

  • Production Support: Support Quality Technicians by identifying improvement opportunities to prevent non-conformities and minimize production disruptions.

  • Quality Gates Development: Develop new quality gates and continuously improve existing to enhance product quality and process control.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's degree or SSST in Electrical Engineering or related field.

  • Minimum five years of experience in quality or equivalent role.

  • Deep understanding of quality processes, including problem-solving methodologies and continuous improvement tools.

  • Communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels. Willingness to work beyond standard hours when required and ability to perform efficiently in demanding situations.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage tasks efficiently and collaboratively in a constantly evolving manufacturing environment characterized by regular adjustments and shifts.

  • Fluency in English and Italian (written and spoken).

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification is considered an advantage.



More about us

This Position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager


Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this position, you will provide assistance in testing and verification activities on a range of assignments in the UPS products of ABB Smart Power in Quartino. You will be in charge of the testing and verification activities for low- and medium-complexity systems, subsystems, or products.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Defining the troubleshooting procedure and troubleshooting level two, in case a new event occurs not covered by the troubleshooting procedure.

  • Maintaining, changing, and optimizing test instructions for mass production in consultancy with the R&D Engineer (Center of Excellence).

  • Providing technical support during the installation of test objects in the test area.

  • Assisting the Production Supervisor in defining and maintaining the skill matrix for test operators.


• Qualifications for the role

  • At least 3 years of experience in UPS, working as a service technician, or in engineering, testing, etc.

  • Sound knowledge of engineering techniques, processes, and tools, including measurement with a power meter, oscilloscope, etc.

  • A strong focus on safe work practices and dedication to following workplace safety guidelines.

  • A high level of self-motivation, curiosity, and desire to learn about new technologies.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach, and strong written and spoken communication skills.

  • A degree in electrical/electronic or similar field · Fluent in English
